98069745.s: One of the newest and largest shopping centers in Jeddah, with hotel towers and a museum of Islamic art. Open 9:30 am to 11:00 pm; phone 920000262.
98069745.b: Jeddah Park is one of the newest and largest shopping centers in Jeddah. It also includes hotel towers and houses a museum specializing in Islamic art. It has a cinema and a children's play area, along with international and local brands at every price level and a spacious food court to suit all tastes. Phone: 920000262. Open from 9:30 am to 11:30 pm.

98069723.s: Set on the shores of Lake Al-Arbaeen, with international art sculptures scattered among landscaped green lawns. Open 24 hours.
98069723.b: Lake Al-Arbaeen Park is set on the shores of Lake Al-Arbaeen and features international art sculptures scattered among landscaped green lawns. The park combines natural scenery with historic architecture, cultural events and traditional food carts, and is part of Saudi Vision 2030's plan to develop sports tracks and local restaurants that highlight the city's heritage. Open from 9:00 am to 11:40 pm.

98069722.s: One of the first entertainment venues dedicated to live comedy, including stand-up shows. Phone: 0540902020.
98069722.b: The Comedy Club is one of the first entertainment venues dedicated to live comedy, including stand-up shows and more. It has tight security and a warm atmosphere, with popcorn and snacks available inside the hall, and its growing popularity makes tickets harder to book each new season. Phone: 0540902020. Open from 8:00 pm to 11:30 pm (closed Monday and Wednesday).

98069610.s: One of the best places for mountain climbing enthusiasts, with views of the city from the summit and great photo opportunities. Open 24 hours.
98069610.b: Jabal Tahwa is one of the best places for mountain climbing enthusiasts, where you can see the town from the summit and take the best photos. The mountain rises about 1,600 meters above sea level and is surrounded by the beautiful village of Rahwat Al Samid to the east and the green, water-rich Wadi Al Sulayl. It is best to visit at sunrise or sunset for the finest view.

98069609.s: Enjoy paragliding from a mountain summit for an unforgettable view of the city. Open 24 hours; phone 0552201335.
98069609.b: Aseer Paragliding Club offers the chance to enjoy paragliding from a mountain summit, with an unforgettable view of the city. The site has a wide takeoff area and a suitable asphalt surface, with parking for more than 20 cars, and professional paragliders rate it highly for the quality of its air currents. Phone: 0552201335.

98069608.s: One of the most beautiful valleys to enjoy nature, with water flowing around trees and a waterfall cascading beside the road. Open 24 hours.
98069608.b: Wadi Al Sahmain is one of the most beautiful valleys to enjoy nature, with the stream flowing around trees and a waterfall cascading beside the road. Reaching its loveliest spots requires some walking and light climbing along the valley bed, and swimming is possible in some pools. Suitable footwear is recommended, and an early morning visit is best.

98069606.s: A short ride through the sky above Abha, passing several landmarks of the city in a unique misty atmosphere.
98069606.b: The Cable Car Station (Abha Telepherique) takes you on a short ride through the sky above Abha, passing several landmarks of the city in a unique misty atmosphere. It is a pleasant romantic experience, especially in the evening around 6 pm, and booking is recommended on holidays to avoid long waits.

98069605.s: Spend a night in the mountains to break the daily routine, overlooking a rural mountain area. Phone: 0508411896.
98069605.b: Kokh Al Jibal lets you spend a night in the mountains to break the daily routine, overlooking a quintessentially rural mountain area. It has elegant interior decor and a welcome scented with incense, although its location in Tanomah may be somewhat far from the village. Phone: 0508411896.

98069604.s: An unforgettable mountain adventure where two mountains meet and water flows between them. Open 24 hours.
98069604.b: Ain Al Dheebah Waterfalls offer an unforgettable mountain adventure, where two mountains meet and water flows between them for a unique and different experience. The rocky trails require some physical fitness, so the site suits energetic young groups more than older visitors or children. Visitors are asked to collect their litter and keep the site clean.

98069603.s: A rural cottage with a modern touch for short stays, set in green space in the Tabab highlands. Phone: 0552723873.
98069603.b: Kokh Al Sarw is a rural cottage with a modern touch for short stays, set in green space in the atmosphere of the Tabab highlands. It is known for its cleanliness and beauty and the calm of its surroundings, and is an ideal destination to break the routine and enjoy a cool mountain atmosphere. Phone: 0552723873.

98069587.s: Enjoy enchanting views over Tihamah, with a trail for walking and cycling.
98069587.b: The hiking trail and cycling path in Al Soudah lets you enjoy enchanting views over Tihamah, with a trail for walking and cycling. It suits nature and sports lovers looking for a refreshing atmosphere, although some visitors note the need for an official camping area and clearer signage for non-residents.

98069586.s: Watch enchanting sunsets from heights overlooking rural villages, with trees and mountains amid the mist. Open 24 hours.
98069586.b: Al Azizah Viewpoint lets you watch enchanting sunsets from heights overlooking rural villages, with views of trees clustered on the mountain amid the mist. Visitors are advised to take precautions for the sometimes rainy and changeable weather. Restrooms are available, and it is an ideal destination for nature photography lovers.

98069585.s: Watch enchanting sunsets from heights overlooking nearby rural villages. Open 24 hours.
98069585.b: Aqabat Habu lets you watch enchanting sunsets from heights overlooking the nearby rural villages. It is one of the most beautiful natural views in Saudi Arabia, with a view above the clouds, and is known for a cable car offering a wonderful view (25 riyals per hour). Its proximity to strawberry farms makes it an enjoyable additional stop.

98069584.s: An 8 km trail linking two areas of different terrain and climate, suitable for hiking or running. Open 24 hours.
98069584.b: Al Saada Trail (also known as Aqabat Fu Al Qadam) is a historic trail eight kilometers long that links two areas of different terrain and climate, and is a good choice for hiking or running. The view of the mountain peaks and valleys is among the finest in the region, especially in cool, misty weather, although the site needs better signage and services. Phone: 0502166240.

98069582.s: The first modern Korean-style cafe in Abha, serving different kinds of boba and many drinks with innovative, unique flavors. Open 4:00 pm to 12:00 am; phone 0595475775.
98069582.b: OSAN Cafe is the first modern Korean-style cafe in Abha, serving different kinds of boba along with many drinks with innovative and unique flavors. It is known for matcha boba drinks and for bingsu, a Korean dessert that is rare in the city, and has a distinctive Asian atmosphere that transports you to a completely different experience. Phone: 0595475775. Open from 4:00 pm to 12:00 midnight.
98069582.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Al Wardatayn, Abha 62521

98069579.s: Its atmosphere changes with each season of the year, and it serves the most delicious French toast in Mahayil. Open 6:00 am to 1:00 am; phone 0531862013.
98069579.b: Spot Cafe is unique in that its atmosphere changes with each season of the year, and it serves the most delicious French toast in Mahayil. It is located inside a shopping complex in the city center and is known for filter coffee and oriental coffee. It suits visitors to Mahayil Aseer looking for a comfortable coffee break. Phone: 0531862013. Open from 6:00 am to 1:00 am.
98069579.a: King Faisal Road, Al Khalidiyah, Mahayil Aseer 63687

98069578.s: A warm atmosphere between past and present, serving coffee and desserts with a unique taste. Open 7:00 am to 12:00 am.
98069578.b: Sthab Cafe has a warm atmosphere between past and present, serving coffee and desserts with a unique taste. Its name is inspired by the aromatic rue plant known in southern Saudi Arabia, and its decor is inspired by calm Korean-style cafes. Open from 7:00 am to 12:00 midnight.

98069577.s: A cafe and roastery serving delicious summer drinks made with coffee and ice cream, alongside many desserts. Open 7:00 am to 12:00 am; phone 0532078781.
98069577.b: Flint Roastery & Cafe is a cafe and roastery known for delicious summer drinks made with coffee and ice cream, alongside many desserts. It is famous for warm, soft cookies and Spanish latte, and has a warm atmosphere and friendly staff inside Garden Square complex. Phone: 0532078781. Open from 7:00 am to 12:00 midnight.
98069577.a: Garden Square Complex, King Abdulaziz Road, Al Wardatayn, Abha 62521

98069576.s: Known for waffles in many tasty flavors and coffee of every kind. Open 7:00 am to 12:30 am.
98069576.b: Okaf is known for waffles in many tasty flavors, and also serves coffee of every kind for a great combination. It is famous for its cafe latte and Saidi dates, and has a calm indoor and outdoor atmosphere despite its small size. Open from 7:00 am to 12:30 am.
98069576.a: King Fahd Branch Road, Al Aran, Abha 62528

98069575.s: The warmth of southern hospitality with the finest coffee, specializing in Yemeni beans. Open 7:00 pm to 12:00 am; phone 0556098865.
98069575.b: Cove Cafe offers the pleasure of a warm southern atmosphere with the finest coffee, and is known for its Yemeni beans. It is famous for its delicious pecan dessert and has refined service and attention to detail, despite its relatively small size. Phone: 0556098865. Open from 7:00 pm to 12:00 midnight.
98069575.a: Al Rawdah, Al Matar District, Abha 62437

98069574.s: A rustic-style cafe serving specialty coffee and breakfast dishes, set up for photo sessions. Open 7:00 am to 2:00 am; phone 0550555343.
98069574.b: Nash is a rustic-style cafe serving specialty coffee and special breakfast dishes, and the place is set up for photo sessions. It is known for its latte and honey cake, has attractive decor that mixes rustic and modern styles, and booking is recommended during peak summer times. Phone: 0550555343. Open from 7:00 am to 2:00 am.
98069574.a: King Fahd Road, Al Mahalah, Abha 62561

98069573.s: Known for quality drinks, excellent coffee beans and competitive prices, serving only French pastries. Open 7:00 am to 1:00 am; phone 0552021819.
98069573.b: Doubleyou is known for the quality of its drinks, excellent coffee beans and competitive prices, and serves only French pastries. It is very popular, with an authentic warm Saudi atmosphere, and is known for refreshing drinks and the friendly service of its staff. Phone: 0552021819. Open from 7:00 am to 1:00 am.
98069573.a: King Fahd Road, Hajlah, Khamis Mushait 62563

98069568.s: Distinctive atmosphere and decor with a luxurious view, serving a variety of specialty coffees and desserts. Open 7:00 am to 2:00 am; phone 0536663477.
98069568.b: La Dose Cafe has a distinctive atmosphere and decor with a luxurious view, and serves a variety of specialty coffees and desserts. It has a three-story design with terraces overlooking the city and beautiful green scenery, although parking can sometimes be hard to find because of its proximity to the main roundabout. Phone: 0536663477.
98069568.a: Hizam, King Abdulaziz Road, Al Shafa, Abha 62521

98069567.s: Its name is inspired by adornment and beauty, and it has an attractive character. Open 24 hours.
98069567.b: Namq Cafe takes its name from adornment and beauty and has an attractive character. It is known for its elegant heritage decor and excellent service from the staff, despite occasional crowding, and it is open around the clock every day of the week.

98069566.s: Inspired by the aromatic wezzab plant added to tea, a different mark among the region's cafes. Open 6:30 am to 2:00 am; phone 0562414479.
98069566.b: Wezzab Cafe is inspired by the aromatic wezzab plant added to tea, a different mark among the region's cafes. It is known for its distinctive tea, cheese qurs bread and sweet shawarma, and offers self-service at very reasonable prices. Phone: 0562414479. Open from 6:30 am to 2:00 am.
98069566.a: Al Miyah Road, Airport Junction, Abha 62439
